message:
feat(context): add public SDK end-to-end editing acceptance sample

Exercise a complete 14,660-byte synthetic HTML source, version-checked exact edits and persisted continuity across independent stack lifecycles. Reuse ordinary StateStore CAS through curated SDK aliases; do not retry uncertain writes. Expose bounded prepared-context diagnostics and local inspection without inference. Include migration, interruption and RC verification instructions without claiming a release.

Go 1.26.4 sample race suite passes (80.5% statement coverage), including real Bifrost HTTP/SSE compaction and 128 two-pool SQLite writer races. Phase 269 smoke with a disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster passes 13 OK, 0 SKIP, 0 FAIL. Scoped pinned lint, full Markdown (596 files), build/help, mirror and whitespace checks pass. Correct earlier phase progress prose; all final-tree review/preflight/coverage/CI gates and RC publication remain separate. No paid provider call or new production dependency.
